scope: Separate pilot; the reviewed DEV-040 convergence-controlled full study remains unregistered and undispatched
question: Does focusing frozen-head supervision on mature target-wait labels improve residual reissued-cancellation prediction and cost beyond uniform refitting?
initialization: seed+40000; actual preserved constructors; no original DEV-036 checkpoint claimed
backbone_recipe: B2/H512; AdamW lr.002 wd.0001; dense FP32 gradients with finite FP64 norm clipping1; mean pre/post common random-inspection CE on all8 entities and3 queries
head_recipe: Original untouched; MLP copies original44-64-2 head, lr.002; linear44-2 fresh seed+41000, lr.02; AdamW wd.0001; 500 full-batch updates. Loss interventions start identically within each head family. No tuning/selection of heads or learning rates.
balanced_loss: Half normalized weight on mature target-wait labels (equal role counts); half on every remaining label. Labels/role/target selection supervise loss only and are not model inputs.
cohorts: All three models and all seeds share each head/calibration/evaluation cohort. Each uses a distinct dev040a split namespace, H512, delays32/128/512, four roles and before/at/after, paired opposites. Backbone streams vary by seed and match across architectures. No configuration-generalization claim.
freeze: Within each seed job all3 backbones,15 heads,18 probes and all calibrators are fitted and saved in a hashed manifest before evaluation is generated. Concurrent seed jobs use code/recipes frozen before dispatch; no human selection during the run. This is development, not the globally sealed full study.
probe_recipe: Reissued/mature only,96 training worlds; identical fixed standardized logistic fit500 Adam updates lr.03 plus.01 weight-square penalty; primary feature is existing44D pre-head input. Fully random initial model control and trained encoder/query/adapter with writer reset to matched initial state. Query14D/current-observation-plus-query30D controls. Shuffle flips paired training-label orientations; evaluates true labels. No raw history bypass.
primary: Bounded-MTSK mature reissued target-wait accuracy: mlp_balanced minus mlp_uniform;192 evaluation worlds per seed
primary_support_rule: mean gain>=.05, exploratory paired3-seed95% Student-t df2 lower>0, and no negative seed difference. Failure means inconclusive/negative for this pilot; no architectural impossibility conclusion.
secondary: linear versus MLP and original head
fixed and calibrated physical cost/failures/unnecessary services
inspection_policy: No inspections at evaluation; none charged. This pilot cannot establish active sensing.
calibration: Per-head minimize labeled simulator cost on calibration only; tie choose closest to.25 then smaller threshold. Retain fixed.25. Services iff p_wait-p_service exceeds threshold. No evaluation selection.
utility_rule: Separately report calibrated balanced-minus-uniform mean cost<=0 and absolute failures/unnecessary services; never infer fewer failures from lower cost alone.
evidence: Nine backbone/initial/optimizer snapshots,45 prediction heads,54 probes; all fit/evaluation features, conditions, labels, logits, actions, calibrations and raw reports. Separate-process exact inference/head-fit/probe replay, then stdlib simulator/action/cost audit. Upload all seed evidence before aggregate results publication; publish complete archive digest and compact per-seed CSV/JSON.
excluded_claims: Learned writer superiority from a positive probe alone
